subject: Pilot alignment: Hosted trial constraints and endpoint mapping for BrainWave AI
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@brainwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot alignment: Hosted trial constraints and endpoint mapping for BrainWave AI

Hi Priya — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock down a hosted trial that matches BrainWave's constraints.

Recap from the call:
- Goal: 4-week hosted evaluation to validate entity extraction throughput + latency at peak traffic profiles.
- Primary constraint: SOC2-equivalent handling for pilot data, US data residency.
- Traffic profile: short LLM prompts (avg 120 tokens in), bursts up to ~60 reqs/s (expected avg 10–15 reqs/s) with occasional microbursts.

What we recommend for a hosted quickstart (proposal):
1) Sandbox endpoints: dedicated sandbox endpoints with API keys scoped to the pilot project.
2) Rate window: default soft cap 50 reqs/s, hard cap 75 reqs/s for the sandbox; we can tune after the first week.
3) Prefetch / KV caching: enable prefix caching for repeated prefixes (helps cost/latency).
4) Data residency: hosted, US-only region with tenant-level isolation and audit logs (we'll provide SOC2 evidence).

Action items (proposed):
- Priya: confirm that US-residency + hosted trial is acceptable for the pilot (or confirm if a Dedicated/VPC is required from day 1).
- Ben: provision sandbox endpoints + generate scoped API keys once Priya confirms.
- Mina: share redwood-security-faq.pdf and the SOC2 artifact checklist; coordinate with BrainWave's security contact.

Attachments: initial mapping workbook (mutual_action_plan draft) attached for sequencing and owners.

Can you confirm the residency requirement and the tentative start week (we suggested Apr 29 as a target)? If Dedicated or Private is required for the pilot, we can map costs and timeline, but that will extend time-to-first-test by ~2–3 weeks.

Thanks — I’ll hold off provisioning until we hear back.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales (Hosted & Dedicated)
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Priya Sharma <priya@brainwave.ai>

Cc: eng-team@brainwave.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot alignment: Hosted trial constraints and endpoint mapping for BrainWave AI

Thanks, Logan — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Residency/compliance: For the pilot we can accept hosted US residency provided the data is logically isolated and we receive the SOC2 checklist and evidence you mentioned. Production will likely need a VPC/Dedicated path, but we want to prove the integration first on hosted.

2) Rate profile: The 50 reqs/s soft cap sounds fine for initial testing. Two things we need to verify: token-based cost (approx $/1k tokens) for the model you plan to run, and the latency SLO at 75% and 95th percentiles for 120-token inputs.

3) Security contact: forwarding to our security lead (selena@brainwave.ai) to confirm the SOC2 artifacts and to add any additional checklist items.

4) Sandbox start date: Apr 29 is good as a target if sandbox endpoints can be ready and we get API keys with a short setup doc.

Quote for context:
> On Thu, Apr 18, 2029 at 9:12 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Can you confirm the residency requirement and the tentative start week (we suggested Apr 29 as a target)? If Dedicated or Private is required for the pilot, we can map costs and timeline, but that will extend time-to-first-test by ~2–3 weeks.

We'd prefer to avoid Dedicated for the pilot to move faster. Please send the mutual action plan and the security FAQ; Ben and Mina, looped above — any additional ops preflight we should schedule a short call to cover?

—Priya

Great — thanks for confirming, Priya. Next steps locked and details below.

What we’ll deliver before Apr 29 start:
- Ben: sandbox endpoints + scoped API key (ETA Apr 24) — endpoints will be in us-west-2 and tagged for BrainWave pilot.
- Mina: security package: SOC2 evidence pointers + redwood-security-faq.pdf (ETA Apr 22).
- Logan: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (attached) with week-by-week milestones for the 4-week pilot, success criteria (throughput, latency, accuracy checks), and rollback rules.

Endpoint & rate defaults for the sandbox (we can update these after week 1):
- Sandbox endpoint: https://sandbox.api.redwood-inference.com/v1/brainwave-pilot
- Soft cap: 50 reqs/s (429 returned when exceeded with Retry-After).
- Hard cap: 75 reqs/s (immediate throttling during microbursts).
- Concurrency: default 200 concurrent tokens-in-flight; we can lower if you hit memory constraints.

Costs & model notes:
- Model: rw-large-16B (quantized) suggested for the pilot. Estimated token unit cost: $0.18 / 1k tokens for generation + $0.06 / 1k tokens for embeddings (approx; will provide exact pricing sheet).
- We’ll include a short perf snapshot: 95th latency for 120-token prompts is typically ~220–320ms in our hosted trials under similar profiles (we’ll run a preflight test).

Action items (owners & dates):
- Priya — confirm acceptance of the US-hosted sandbox and share any security questions by Apr 20.
- Ben — provision sandbox and deliver keys by Apr 24.
- Mina — send security package by Apr 22.
- Logan — finalize mutual_action_plan.xlsx and share Doc link by EOD Apr 18.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood-security-faq.pdf

If that plan looks good I’ll open the HubSpot deal task and schedule a short ops preflight call (30m) for Apr 25 — Ben and Mina, please indicate availability.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you on sandbox.
